packageRules.description: Surefire 3.6.0 dropped surefire-testng; Cucumber TestNG then discovers 0 scenarios.
Cucumber 8 removed GlueDiscoverySelectorResolver. ATAF 0.3.4 still uses the Cucumber 7 TestNG runner. See GH-3465.
In-range npm overrides must bump package.json. A lockfile-only update runs `npm install pkg@version`, which npm rejects with EOVERRIDE when that spec differs from the override.
Composer lockfile updates must be allowed to move locked transitive packages, such as sebastian/diff when PHPUnit is bumped.
